items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: The sophisticated lady, of course, lock, stock, and barrel is Otto Hardwicks.

ctx.x: Jimmy Noon's solo became the Creole Love Call. Yes. Jimmy Noon's solo in one of the King Oliver pieces.
That's right, became the Creole Love Call. The sophisticated lady, of course, lock, stock, and barrel is Otto Hardwicks. The arrangements were made by...
But isn't, Al, let me ask you this, isn't that the definition of a jazz composer to a certain extent, that he does draw upon his musicians in a way?
